description: Four hooks, each switched by hooks/switches.json (the version's default) and by PLEXARM_HOOKS_OFF / PLEXARM_HOOKS_ON in the environment (per machine). SessionStart runs two: the credential check says so when the guard has no credential — no network call, no block, and silent when healthy; and the agent sync sends the roster this session can see to /records/sync-agents, which CREATES any agent not already in the account and never retires or overwrites, because what a session can see is session-dependent. SubagentStart names the record obligation at spawn — no network call, no credential, cannot block. Stop and SubagentStop ask the Plexarm API whether this person left work in_progress in this project, and block once per agent if so; they hold a credential and fail open on everything except a repository bound to the wrong project. The record guard is OFF in switches.json as of 1.6.0 — still registered, still shipped, and PLEXARM_HOOKS_ON=stop_record_guard turns it back on.
